title: Rafting simulation by Claude 5 Fable
author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
selftext:
I wanted to see if Fable could make a realistic Rafting game.

This was done entirely by Claude, i gave it 0 assets.

comments.author: sharkymcstevenson2
comments.body: Not bad! What was the prompt?

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
I want you to build a Mountain boat river descent game at the level of the most recent AAA games. It should be utterly perfect, visually beautiful, with every single thing done at AAA quality—from textures to physics to anything you could think of. Fan out sub-agents and have sub-agents tackle each one individually so that the game is utterly perfect. You should /loop on each item and have a separate sub-agent check it visually to ensure it looks triple A. That separate sub-agent should be a really harsh critic, and if it doesn't look triple A, it should keep going. Don't stop until each sub-agent is utterly wowed with the quality when compared with the actual AAA games. It should literally compare them side by side blind and say which one looks better. Do this in ThreeJS. /loop until it's utterly perfect. Fan out sub-agents and ultracode. HOWEVER. Here is how the game works: Your boat start the top of a big descent. it should last around 1 minute the descent the slope should not be too extreme cuz otherwise u would need to create too much terrain, but we do want an impressive descent speed. a video of our descent should WOW people. its possible to make it less than 1 minute if that is too difficult, because we do want good descent speed AND not too much lag. The terrain is a mix of trees, WATER, rocks, terrain. The player can maneuver either "left" or right with A or D. it goes down by itself. Its at moonlight, and the moon does amazing reflection on the water. when player reach the bottom, it records his time and he gets some sort of option to try again the player is limited in how far left or right he can go. there should be natural walls preventing him from going too far left or too far right BUT FIRST ASK ME QUESTIONS TO MAKE SURE U TAKE THE RIGHT DIRECTIOON  
  
this is first person gameplay from the boat (No character)  
the descent needs to look somewhat extreme, a bit like heavy rafting.  
there could be some wind for the vegetation.  
  
for graphics setting, by defaut put it on "optimized", where u aim for good graphics but good performance. eg dont go crazy on shadows fi that is gonna cost too much. should run on a 4070 graphics card.

  
\_\_\_\_

  
note: i had to iterate a bit. it did not come out perfect on first try

replies.author: nfxdav
replies.body: Did it take the right directioon?

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body: It's hard to explain but when u try to make the curve super steep and super long, it doesn't actually feel that nice. Frequent changes feels better. so i had to change the direction a few times.

comments.author: oVerde
comments.body:
Stop! ✋

Dont make me believe in it then sink a month of hours and tokens trying it and not getting even close to the posted results.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
Ok just as a disclaimer...

The below prompt was given to Fable. But then i ran into some issues (the mountains were invisible) and i had Sol debug it.

Then i had to do some testing to reach a "fun" course.
